'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***At least four [[Palestinians]] are killed and one other is wounded when [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] open fire on a vehicle in [[Nablus]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [[List of political parties in the State of Palestine|Palestinian factions]] call for a [[general strike]] on Thursday in response to the attack. *[[2024 Hadera stabbing attack]]
**Six people are injured, two critically, in a [[mass stabbing]] in [[Hadera]], [[Haifa District]], [[Israel]]. The attacker is shot dead by [[Israel Police|police]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/6-injured-2-critically-in-terrorist-stabbing-spree-in-hadera (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**One [[Frontier Corps]] official and two [[terrorism in Pakistan|terrorists]] are killed and thirteen others are injured by a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] and gun attack on a [[Frontier Corps]] post in [[Zhob]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://dailyausaf.com/en/pakistan/one-fc-official-martyred-as-security-forces-thwart-attack-in-balochistans-zhob/#google_vignette (Daily Ausaf)]

**Two people are killed by a [[Hezbollah]] rocket fired at [[Kiryat Shmona]], Israel. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98yklj023xo (BBC News)] [https://www.mdais.org/en/news/091024-kiryatshmona (MDA Israel)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The head of the [[Rapid Support Forces]], [[Hemedti]], accuses [[Egypt]] of being involved in [[airstrike]]s on the group's troops during the ongoing [[civil war]] in [[Sudan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/head-sudans-rsf-accuses-egypt-being-involved-airstrikes-groups-troops-2024-10-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Nansen Refugee Award]]
**[[Scalabrinian]] nun [[religious sister|sister]] Rosita Milesi is awarded the Nansen Refugee Award by the [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]] for her work with [[refugee]]s and [[internally displaced people]] in [[Brazil]] for over 40 years. [https://www.dw.com/en/brazilian-nun-wins-un-refugee-prize/a-70440357 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Milton]]
***More than 5.5 million people in [[Florida]], [[United States]], are currently under [[emergency evacuation|evacuation orders]] as Hurricane Milton weakens into a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|category 4 hurricane]] ahead of its expected landfall in the early hours of Thursday. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/10/08/weather/hurricane-milton-florida-evacuations.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurricane-milton-florida-landfall-path-storm/ (CBS News)]
***Several [[tornado]]es are reported in Florida, including along [[Interstate 75]], ahead of Hurricane Milton's landfall. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cr753r34n3rt (BBC News)]
***Milton makes landfall as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|category 3 hurricane]] near [[Siesta Key, Florida|Siesta Key]] on Florida's Western Coast. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurricane-milton-florida-landfall-path-storm/ (CBS News)]
***The [[Tropicana Field]] roof in [[St. Petersburg, Florida|St. Petersburg]] is damaged by winds caused from Hurricane Milton. [https://www.tampabay.com/hurricane/2024/10/10/hurricane-milton-tears-open-tropicana-fields-roof/ (''Tampa Bay Times'')]  
*Five people are killed when a [[Beechcraft Baron]] [[aircraft crash]]es shortly after takeoff from [[Catalina Airport]] in [[Avalon, California|Avalon]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/5-dead-after-a-small-plane-crashes-on-santa-catalina-island-off-the-southern-california-coast-1.7068143 (CTV News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ecuador–United States relations]]
**The [[U.S. State Department]] bans former [[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian president]] [[Rafael Correa]] and former [[vice president of Ecuador|vice president]] [[Jorge Glas]] from entering the [[United States]] on accusations of [[corruption in Ecuador|corruption]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/former-ecuador-president-vice-president-barred-entering-us-2024-10-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Japan]]
**[[Japan]]'s former longest-serving [[death row]] prisoner, [[Iwao Hakamada]], is confirmed innocent after the prosecution waives their right to appeal the September 26 "not guilty" verdict from his [[retrial]]. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/news/html/20241009/k10014604701000.html (NHK)]
*[[Censorship in Turkey]]
**[[Turkey]] bans the [[social media]] platform [[Discord]] after it allegedly refused to give [[Government of Turkey|government]] officials information related to "[[child sexual abuse]] and [[obscenity]]" and the [[murder]] of two women in [[Istanbul]] last week. [https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-blocks-discord-messaging-platform/a-70445259 (DW)]
*[[South Africa's genocide case against Israel]]
**[[Bolivia]] formally joins [[South Africa]]'s case in the [[International Court of Justice]] regarding Israel's conduct in the [[Gaza Strip]] as [[genocide]], stating it "has a responsibility to condemn the crime of genocide". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/9/bolivia-joins-south-africas-icj-genocide-case-against (Al Jazeera)]
